body: Use case stylized-concept. Production 2D fantasy game layered sprite cutouts in Arcane Vanguard style: clean cel-shaded painted forms, bold readable silhouettes, restrained details, crisp dark contours. Starweaver archmage, elderly silverbearded male with tall purple wizard hat, rich violet robes with silver constellation embroidery and turquoise sash, deep purple rear cape. Weapons separate, no staff or orb on this body sheet. Exact portrait1024x1536 layout SIXcolumns TWELVErows. Columns true distinct E rightprofile; SE frontright; SW frontLEFT; W leftprofile; NW rearleft; NE rearRIGHT showing back of head. 72 SEPARATE parts. Rows HEAD, torso without head or arms, rear cape, pelvis/belt, left upperarm, right upperarm, left forearm with hand, right forearm with hand, left leg without boot, right leg without boot, left boot, right boot. Neutral straight joints. Generous transparent gaps, especially head vs torso. Never attach body pieces. No assembled character, weapons, text, labels, grid, scenery, background, glow or shadows. Truly transparent background.
equipment: Production game equipment cutout sheet in cel-shaded Arcane Vanguard fantasy style. ONE ROW SIX distinct angle views of a purple and silver staff topped with a delicate crescent enclosing a small turquoise star. Upright staffs, grip near lower third, no hands, no body, no detached glow. Column angles E,SE,SW,W,NW,NE. Crisp dark contours, clean painted shading, alpha-transparent background. Each of six staffs centered in its equal column with wide clear transparent gaps and margins. Landscape1536x1024. No labels, scenery, text, shadows or other pieces.
effects: Production game visual effects atlas in clean cel-shaded painted Arcane Vanguard fantasy style. Exact six columns four rows, each row is six sequential animation frames: purple turquoise meteor projectile with starry tail; violet meteor explosion with silver star sparks; concentric constellation casting circle; swirling violet stardust arrival. Landscape1536x1024. Each frame centered in equal cell with generous transparent gaps on all sides. No labels, no grid lines, no background, no shadows. True alpha transparency between colored sparks. Do not merge cells.
